```python
from seed_emulator import Emulator, AutonomousSystem, Network, Router, Host, InternetExchange, Layer

# Create the emulator
emu = Emulator()

# Create AS150 as a transit AS with 4 routers and 3 networks
as150 = AutonomousSystem(asn=150, name="AS150")
net150_1 = Network(name="AS150-Net1")
net150_2 = Network(name="AS150-Net2")
net150_3 = Network(name="AS150-Net3")
r150_1 = Router(name="AS150-R1")
r150_2 = Router(name="AS150-R2")
r150_3 = Router(name="AS150-R3")
r150_4 = Router(name="AS150-R4")

# Attach routers to AS150
as150.attach(r150_1)
as150.attach(r150_2)
as150.attach(r150_3)
as150.attach(r150_4)

# Attach networks to AS150
as150.attach(net150_1)
as150.attach(net150_2)
as150.attach(net150_3)

# Connect routers to networks within AS150
r150_1.joinNetwork(net150_1)
r150_2.joinNetwork(net150_2)
r150_3.joinNetwork(net150_3)
# Optionally, connect routers together for transit
r150_1.joinNetwork(net150_2)
r150_2.joinNetwork(net150_3)
r150_3.joinNetwork(net150_1)
r150_4.joinNetwork(net150_1)
r150_4.joinNetwork(net150_2)
r150_4.joinNetwork(net150_3)

# Create AS151 with a router and a web host, and a network
as151 = AutonomousSystem(asn=151, name="AS151")
net151 = Network(name="AS151-Net")
r151 = Router(name="AS151-R1")
web151 = Host(name="AS151-WebHost")

as151.attach(r151)
as151.attach(net151)
as151.attach(web151)

# Connect router and host to the network
r151.joinNetwork(net151)
web151.joinNetwork(net151)

# Create AS152 with a router and a web host, and a network
as152 = AutonomousSystem(asn=152, name="AS152")
net152 = Network(name="AS152-Net")
r152 = Router(name="AS152-R1")
web152 = Host(name="AS152-WebHost")

as152.attach(r152)
as152.attach(net152)
as152.attach(web152)

# Connect router and host to the network
r152.joinNetwork(net152)
web152.joinNetwork(net152)

# Create an Internet Exchange and have AS151 and AS152 join it
ix = InternetExchange(name="IX-1")
as151.joinInternetExchange(ix)
as152.joinInternetExchange(ix)

# Set up BGP peering between AS150 and AS151, and between AS150 and AS152
as150.addPrivatePeering(as151)
as150.addPrivatePeering(as152)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(as150)
emu.addLayer(as151)
emu.addLayer(as152)
emu.addLayer(ix)

# Dump the emulator's state to a binary file
emu.dump("emulator_state.bin")
```
